firm_data.firm_description: Goldberg Segalla is a national civil litigation firm with a diverse team of attorneys, partnering with clients to understand their business and industry and anticipate challenges. They mobilize resources quickly to minimize risk and maximize favorable outcomes.
notable_facts: Recognized by The American Lawyer as one of the top 200 law firms in the nation.
Recognized by Chambers USA as among the elite firms in several practice areas.
Designated as a Mansfield Certified firm for ensuring fair and equitable leadership opportunities for historically underrepresented attorneys.

additional_contacts.name: David L. Brown
additional_contacts.title: Co-chair of Goldberg Segalla’s Global Insurance Services practice

email.subject: AI for Goldberg Segalla, built for national civil litigation firms
email.body:
Hi Christopher,

Goldberg Segalla's recognition by The American Lawyer as a top 200 firm speaks to your team's excellence in civil litigation and insurance coverage. That level of sophistication paired with a 500-attorney operation means you're managing complex cases at scale, which is exactly where AI becomes the difference between staying ahead and drowning in motion practice.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of national practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency without the overhead.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now meeting with regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by Buffalo and share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete and scale.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
